queries.sql: INSERT INTO apiome.version_content_counts AS r (version_id, content_stamp, class_count, class_property_count, max_class_created_at, counted_at) SELECT s.id, s.content_stamp, cc.class_count, cc.class_property_count, cc.max_class_created_at, now() FROM ( SELECT t.id, t.content_stamp FROM ( SELECT v.id, v.content_stamp FROM apiome.versions v JOIN apiome.projects p ON p.id = v.project_id WHERE p.tenant_id IN (SELECT tenant_id FROM apiome.tenant_users WHERE user_id = $1) UNION SELECT v.id, v.content_stamp FROM apiome.versions v WHERE v.creator_id = $1 ) t LEFT JOIN apiome.version_content_counts k ON k.version_id = t.id WHERE k.version_id IS NULL OR k.content_stamp <> t.content_stamp ORDER BY t.id OFFSET 0 ) s CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS class_count, COALESCE(SUM((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM apiome.class_properties cp WHERE cp.class_id = c.id)), 0)::int AS class_property_count, MAX(c.created_at) AS max_class_created_at FROM apiome.classes c WHERE c.version_id = s.id AND c.deleted_at IS NULL ) cc ON CONFLICT (version_id) DO UPDATE SET content_stamp = EXCLUDED.content_stamp, class_count = EXCLUDED.class_count, class_property_count = EXCLUDED.class_property_count, max_class_created_at = EXCLUDED.max_class_created_at, counted_at = EXCLUDED.counted_at

queries.sql: WITH latest AS ( SELECT p.id AS project_id, p.name AS project_name, p.tenant_id, lv.version_row_id, lv.version_id, lv.published, lv.published_at, lv.updated_at, lv.created_at, GREATEST( COALESCE(lv.published_at, lv.created_at), COALESCE(lv.updated_at, lv.created_at) ) AS touched_at FROM apiome.projects p CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT v.id AS version_row_id, v.version_id, v.published, v.published_at, v.updated_at, v.created_at FROM apiome.versions v WHERE v.project_id = p.id AND v.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY v.created_at DESC NULLS LAST, v.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) lv WHERE p.tenant_id IN (SELECT tenant_id FROM apiome.tenant_users WHERE user_id = $1) AND p.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY touched_at DESC LIMIT $2 ) SELECT l.project_id, l.project_name, t.name AS tenant_name, l.version_id, l.published, l.published_at, l.updated_at, l.created_at, v.metadata, v.quality_score, v.quality_grade, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM apiome.classes c WHERE c.version_id = l.version_row_id AND c.deleted_at IS NULL) AS class_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM apiome.class_properties cp JOIN apiome.classes c2 ON c2.id = cp.class_id WHERE c2.version_id = l.version_row_id AND c2.deleted_at IS NULL) AS property_count FROM latest l JOIN apiome.versions v ON v.id = l.version_row_id JOIN apiome.tenants t ON t.id = l.tenant_id ORDER BY l.touched_at DESC

queries.source: apiome-rest/src/app/usage_ingest_store.py _admission (every usage ingest batch, under the tenant lock: cap, today's usage_tenant_day counter, newly finalized days; DBP-1.8 #7191)
queries.sql: SELECT (SELECT CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(l.seats -> 'usage_events_per_day') = 'number' THEN (l.seats ->> 'usage_events_per_day')::numeric::bigint ELSE 100000 END FROM apiome.tenants t LEFT JOIN apiome.tenant_licenses tl ON tl.tenant_id = t.id LEFT JOIN apiome.licenses l ON l.id = tl.license_id WHERE t.id = $1::uuid LIMIT 1) AS cap, COALESCE((SELECT d.events_used FROM apiome.usage_tenant_day d WHERE d.tenant_id = $1::uuid AND d.day = date '2026-06-15'), 0) AS used, ARRAY(SELECT r.day FROM apiome.usage_rollup_days r WHERE r.day = ANY (ARRAY[date '2026-06-15']) AND r.finalized_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY r.day) AS finalized

queries.sql: WITH ranked AS ( SELECT b.project_id, b.latest_version_id, b.version_count, b.latest_published_at FROM apiome.browse_public_projects b ORDER BY b.version_count DESC, b.latest_published_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT $1 ) SELECT p.id, p.name, p.slug, p.description, t.name as tenant_name, t.slug as tenant_slug, rk.version_count, rk.latest_published_at, cf.operation_count, cf.schema_count, cf.quality_grade, cf.quality_score, cf.mock_enabled, cf.sdk_available, cf.facts_format, cf.facts_published_at FROM ranked rk JOIN apiome.projects p ON p.id = rk.project_id JOIN apiome.tenants t ON t.id = p.tenant_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COALESCE(f_v.operation_count, (SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM apiome.version_path f_vp JOIN apiome.path_operation f_po ON f_po.version_path_id = f_vp.id WHERE f_vp.version_id = f_v.id)) AS operation_count, COALESCE(f_v.schema_count, (SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM apiome.classes f_c WHERE f_c.version_id = f_v.id AND f_c.deleted_at IS NULL)) AS schema_count, NULLIF(TRIM(f_v.quality_grade), '') AS quality_grade, f_v.quality_score::int AS quality_score, COALESCE(f_v.mock_enabled, false) AS mock_enabled, COALESCE(( SELECT f_s.settings -> 'publicSdkEnabled' = 'true'::jsonb FROM apiome.sdk_generation_settings f_s WHERE f_s.tenant_id = f_p.tenant_id AND (f_s.project_id = f_p.id OR f_s.project_id IS NULL) AND f_s.settings ? 'publicSdkEnabled' ORDER BY f_s.project_id NULLS LAST LIMIT 1 ), false) AS sdk_available, NULLIF(LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(f_v.source_format, ''))), '') AS facts_format, f_v.published_at AS facts_published_at FROM apiome.versions f_v JOIN apiome.projects f_p ON f_p.id = f_v.project_id WHERE f_v.id = rk.latest_version_id ) cf ON TRUE WHERE t.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY version_count DESC, latest_published_at DESC NULLS LAST

queries.sql: WITH wanted AS ( SELECT * FROM unnest($1::text[], $2::text[], $3::text[], $4::text[], $5::text[], $6::text[]) AS w(hit_id, tenant_slug, project_slug, hit_type, method, item_key) ), located AS ( SELECT w.hit_id, w.hit_type, w.method, w.item_key, p.id AS project_id, b.version_count FROM wanted w JOIN apiome.tenants t ON t.slug = w.tenant_slug AND t.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN apiome.projects p ON p.tenant_id = t.id AND p.slug = w.project_slug AND p.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN apiome.browse_public_projects b ON b.project_id = p.id ) SELECT w.hit_id, w.version_count, (SELECT json_agg(json_build_object( 'version_slug', pv.version_slug, 'published_at', pv.published_at, 'has_anchor', CASE WHEN w.hit_type = 'operation' THEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM apiome.version_path vp JOIN apiome.path_operation po ON po.version_path_id = vp.id WHERE vp.version_id = pv.version_pk AND vp.pathname = w.item_key AND UPPER(po.operation) = w.method) WHEN w.hit_type = 'schema' THEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM apiome.classes c WHERE c.version_id = pv.version_pk AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.name = w.item_key) ELSE NULL END ) ORDER BY pv.published_at DESC NULLS LAST, pv.created_at DESC) FROM ( SELECT v.id AS version_pk, v.version_id AS version_slug, v.published_at, v.created_at FROM apiome.versions v WHERE v.project_id = w.project_id AND v.published = true AND v.visibility = 'public' AND v.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY v.published_at DESC NULLS LAST, v.created_at DESC LIMIT $7 ) pv) AS versions FROM located w

queries.sql: SELECT tenant_id, project_id, title, updated_at FROM ( ( SELECT l.tenant_id, l.project_id, p.name AS title, l.public_listed_at AS updated_at FROM apiome.mcp_project_listing l INNER JOIN apiome.projects p ON p.id = l.project_id WHERE (l.public_listed_at IS NOT NULL) AND (p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.enabled IS TRUE) AND (l.tenant_id <> $1) AND (TRUE) ORDER BY l.public_listed_at DESC, l.tenant_id DESC, l.project_id DESC LIMIT $2 ) UNION ALL ( SELECT l.tenant_id, l.project_id, p.name AS title, l.listed_at AS updated_at FROM apiome.mcp_project_listing l INNER JOIN apiome.projects p ON p.id = l.project_id WHERE (l.listed_at IS NOT NULL) AND (p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.enabled IS TRUE) AND (l.tenant_id = $3) AND (TRUE) ORDER BY l.listed_at DESC, l.tenant_id DESC, l.project_id DESC LIMIT $4 ) ) AS merged ORDER BY updated_at DESC, tenant_id DESC, project_id DESC LIMIT $5

queries.name: mcp.spec_search_page
queries.source: apiome-mcp/src/apiome_mcp/spec_search_tool.py build_spec_search_query (spec.search: rank and page on versions, then join the page; about 5,000 matches; DBP-1.22 #7205)
queries.sql: WITH hit AS ( SELECT v.id, v.project_id, v.mcp_listed_at AS updated_at, GREATEST( 1, LEAST( 2147483647, ROUND((ts_rank_cd(v.mcp_public_doc_tsv, plainto_tsquery('english', $1))::numeric) * 1000000)::integer ) ) AS rank_score FROM apiome.versions v WHERE v.mcp_public_doc_tsv @@ plainto_tsquery('english', $1) AND v.mcp_listed_at IS NOT NULL AND v.visibility = 'public'::apiome.visibility_type AND v.deleted_at IS NULL AND v.enabled IS TRUE AND v.published IS TRUE ), page AS ( SELECT id, project_id, updated_at, rank_score FROM hit ORDER BY rank_score DESC, updated_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT $2 ) SELECT page.id, p.tenant_id, page.project_id, p.name AS title, v.version_id AS version, v.description, COALESCE(tg.tags, ARRAY[]::TEXT[]) AS tags, page.updated_at, page.rank_score FROM page INNER JOIN apiome.versions v ON v.id = page.id INNER JOIN apiome.projects p ON p.id = page.project_id AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.enabled IS TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT array_agg(vt.name ORDER BY vt.name) AS tags FROM apiome.version_tags vt WHERE vt.version_id = page.id AND vt.project_id = page.project_id ) tg ON TRUE ORDER BY page.rank_score DESC, page.updated_at DESC, page.id DESC

queries.name: mcp.spec_list_tags_histogram
queries.source: apiome-mcp/src/apiome_mcp/spec_list_tags_tool.py _HISTOGRAM_QUERY (spec.list_tags: every public tag counted once per cache lifetime, 45 s by default, then paged from memory; DBP-1.22 #7205)
queries.sql: SELECT tag, cnt FROM ( SELECT vt.name AS tag, COUNT(*)::bigint AS cnt FROM apiome.version_tags vt INNER JOIN apiome.versions v ON v.id = vt.version_id AND v.project_id = vt.project_id INNER JOIN apiome.projects p ON p.id = v.project_id WHERE v.mcp_listed_at IS NOT NULL AND v.visibility = 'public'::apiome.visibility_type AND v.deleted_at IS NULL AND v.enabled IS TRUE AND v.published IS TRUE AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.enabled IS TRUE GROUP BY vt.name ) AS counts ORDER BY cnt DESC, tag ASC

allowSeqScan.reason: the histogram counts every tag of every public revision; it runs once per cache lifetime, not per call
joined to every tag row: reading the public revisions once is the cheapest plan

queries.name: mcp.openapi_class_properties
queries.source: apiome-mcp/src/apiome_mcp/spec_openapi_loaders.py load_classes_and_properties, statement 2 of 2: every property of a revision's classes, keyed by the revision instead of an IN list of class ids (DBP-1.22 #7205)

queries.name: mcp.openapi_operations
queries.source: apiome-mcp/src/apiome_mcp/spec_openapi_loaders.py load_paths_tree: every operation of a revision (DBP-1.22 #7205)
queries.sql: SELECT po.id, po.version_path_id, po.operation FROM apiome.path_operation po INNER JOIN apiome.version_path vp ON vp.id = po.version_path_id WHERE vp.version_id = $1 ORDER BY po.version_path_id, CASE po.operation WHEN 'GET' THEN 1 WHEN 'POST' THEN 2 WHEN 'PUT' THEN 3 WHEN 'PATCH' THEN 4 WHEN 'DELETE' THEN 5 ELSE 6 END

queries.name: mcp.openapi_parameters
queries.source: apiome-mcp/src/apiome_mcp/spec_openapi_loaders.py load_paths_tree: every operation's parameters (DBP-1.22 #7205)
queries.sql: SELECT popl.path_operation_id AS loader_path_operation_id, spp.id, spp.name, spp.in_location, spp.summary, spp.description, spp.data FROM apiome.shared_path_parameter spp INNER JOIN apiome.path_operation_parameter_link popl ON spp.id = popl.shared_path_parameter_id INNER JOIN apiome.path_operation po ON po.id = popl.path_operation_id INNER JOIN apiome.version_path vp ON vp.id = po.version_path_id WHERE vp.version_id = $1 ORDER BY popl.path_operation_id, CASE spp.in_location WHEN 'path' THEN 1 WHEN 'query' THEN 2 WHEN 'header' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END, spp.name

queries.name: mcp.openapi_request_bodies
queries.source: apiome-mcp/src/apiome_mcp/spec_openapi_loaders.py load_paths_tree: every operation's request body with its content types (DBP-1.22 #7205)
queries.sql: SELECT link.path_operation_id AS loader_path_operation_id, rb.id, rb.name, rb.description, rb.required, COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object( 'id', rbc.id, 'media_type', rbc.media_type, 'class_id', rbc.class_id, 'class_name', c.name, 'inline_schema', rbc.inline_schema, 'encoding', rbc.encoding, 'examples', rbc.examples ) ORDER BY rbc.ctid) FILTER (WHERE rbc.id IS NOT NULL), '[]') as content_types FROM apiome.shared_path_request_body rb INNER JOIN apiome.path_operation_request_body_link link ON rb.id = link.shared_path_request_body_id INNER JOIN apiome.path_operation po ON po.id = link.path_operation_id INNER JOIN apiome.version_path vp ON vp.id = po.version_path_id LEFT JOIN apiome.shared_path_request_body_content rbc ON rb.id = rbc.shared_path_request_body_id LEFT JOIN apiome.classes c ON rbc.class_id = c.id WHERE vp.version_id = $1 GROUP BY link.path_operation_id, rb.id

queries.name: mcp.openapi_responses
queries.source: apiome-mcp/src/apiome_mcp/spec_openapi_loaders.py load_paths_tree: every operation's responses with their content types (DBP-1.22 #7205)
queries.sql: SELECT porl.path_operation_id AS loader_path_operation_id, spr.id, spr.status_code, spr.description, spr.data, spr.class_id, c.name as class_name, spr.inline_schema, COALESCE( json_agg( json_build_object( 'id', rc.id, 'media_type', rc.media_type, 'class_id', rc.class_id, 'class_name', rc_class.name, 'inline_schema', rc.inline_schema, 'examples', rc.examples ) ORDER BY rc.ctid ) FILTER (WHERE rc.id IS NOT NULL), '[]' ) as content_types FROM apiome.shared_path_response spr INNER JOIN apiome.path_operation_response_link porl ON spr.id = porl.shared_path_response_id INNER JOIN apiome.path_operation po ON po.id = porl.path_operation_id INNER JOIN apiome.version_path vp ON vp.id = po.version_path_id LEFT JOIN apiome.classes c ON spr.class_id = c.id LEFT JOIN apiome.shared_path_response_content rc ON spr.id = rc.shared_path_response_id LEFT JOIN apiome.classes rc_class ON rc.class_id = rc_class.id WHERE vp.version_id = $1 GROUP BY porl.path_operation_id, spr.id, spr.status_code, spr.description, spr.data, spr.class_id, c.name, spr.inline_schema ORDER BY porl.path_operation_id, spr.status_code

queries.name: sweep.due_mcp_endpoints
queries.source: apiome-rest/src/app/database.py Database.list_due_mcp_endpoints (MCP discovery sweep tick; idx_mcp_endpoints_discovery_due[_default], V426, DBP-1.18 #7201)

queries.source: apiome-rest/src/app/database.py Database.list_due_mcp_catalog_digests (catalog digest tick; idx_mcp_catalog_digest_configs_due[_default], V426, DBP-1.18 #7201)

queries.name: pact.integrations_pairs
queries.source: apiome-rest/src/app/pact_integrations_store.py PAIRS_SQL (the Contracts landing's integrations list, PFX-8.1 #7298; capped at MAX_INTEGRATIONS pairs)
queries.sql: WITH pairs AS ( SELECT pr.id AS provider_id, pr.slug AS provider_slug, pr.name AS provider_name, c.id AS consumer_id, c.slug AS consumer_slug, c.name AS consumer_name, count(*) OVER () AS pair_total FROM apiome.pacticipant pr CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( WITH RECURSIVE pc AS ( (SELECT p.consumer_id FROM apiome.pact_publication p WHERE p.provider_id = pr.id ORDER BY p.consumer_id LIMIT 1) UNION ALL SELECT (SELECT p.consumer_id FROM apiome.pact_publication p WHERE p.provider_id = pr.id AND p.consumer_id > pc.consumer_id ORDER BY p.consumer_id LIMIT 1) FROM pc WHERE pc.consumer_id IS NOT NULL ) SELECT pc.consumer_id FROM pc WHERE pc.consumer_id IS NOT NULL ) pc JOIN apiome.pacticipant c ON c.id = pc.consumer_id AND c.tenant_id = pr.tenant_id AND c.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE pr.tenant_id = $1::uuid AND pr.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY lower(c.name), lower(pr.name), c.id, pr.id LIMIT $2 ) SELECT pairs.provider_id::text AS provider_id, pairs.provider_slug, pairs.provider_name, pairs.consumer_id::text AS consumer_id, pairs.consumer_slug, pairs.consumer_name, pairs.pair_total, newest.pact_version_id::text AS pact_version_id, newest.sha, newest.consumer_version, newest.published_at FROM pairs CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT p.pact_version_id, pv.sha, v.number AS consumer_version, p.created_at AS published_at FROM apiome.pacticipant_version v JOIN apiome.pact_publication p ON p.consumer_version_id = v.id AND p.consumer_id = v.pacticipant_id AND p.provider_id = pairs.provider_id JOIN apiome.pact_version pv ON pv.id = p.pact_version_id WHERE v.pacticipant_id = pairs.consumer_id AND v.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY v.seq DESC LIMIT 1 ) newest

queries.name: pact.environment_board_deployed
queries.source: apiome-rest/src/app/pact_deployments.py _TOPOLOGY_DEPLOYED (the Environments board and topology, PFX-5.7 #6951 / PFX-8.13 #7310; capped at MAX_TOPOLOGY_ROWS)
queries.sql: SELECT d.environment_id::text AS environment_id, p.slug AS pacticipant_slug, p.name AS pacticipant_name, v.number AS version_number, v.seq AS version_seq, d.application_instance, d.created_at AS recorded_at FROM apiome.deployed_version d JOIN apiome.pacticipant p ON p.id = d.pacticipant_id AND p.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND p.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN apiome.pacticipant_version v ON v.id = d.version_id AND v.pacticipant_id = d.pacticipant_id AND v.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE d.tenant_id = $1::uuid AND d.currently_deployed ORDER BY p.name, p.slug, d.seq DESC LIMIT $2

queries.name: pact.environment_board_released

queries.name: pact.environment_board_idle
queries.source: apiome-rest/src/app/pact_environment_board.py IDLE_SQL (the board's pacticipants with nothing anywhere, PFX-8.13 #7310; capped at MAX_IDLE_ROWS)
queries.sql: SELECT p.slug, p.name FROM apiome.pacticipant p WHERE p.tenant_id = $1::uuid AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM apiome.deployed_version d WHERE d.pacticipant_id = p.id AND d.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND d.currently_deployed) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM apiome.released_version r WHERE r.pacticipant_id = p.id AND r.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND r.currently_supported) ORDER BY p.name, p.slug LIMIT $2

queries.source: apiome-rest/src/app/pact_retention_policy_store.py _DELETED_PACTICIPANTS first page (Contracts Settings → Clean-up, Recently deleted, PFX-8.14 #7311; V456 index)

queries.name: pact.retention_deleted_versions
queries.source: apiome-rest/src/app/pact_retention_policy_store.py _DELETED_VERSIONS first page (Contracts Settings → Clean-up, Recently deleted, PFX-8.14 #7311; V456 index)
queries.sql: SELECT 'version' AS kind, v.id::text AS id, p.id::text AS pacticipant_id, p.slug AS pacticipant_slug, p.name AS pacticipant_name, v.number, v.deleted_at, v.deleted_by_label AS deleted_by, v.delete_cause AS cause, v.delete_reason AS reason, 0 AS versions, (SELECT count(*) FROM apiome.pact_publication pp WHERE pp.consumer_version_id = v.id AND pp.consumer_id = v.pacticipant_id) AS pacts, (SELECT count(*) FROM apiome.verification_result r WHERE r.provider_version_id = v.id AND r.provider_id = v.pacticipant_id) AS results FROM apiome.pacticipant p JOIN apiome.pacticipant_version v ON v.pacticipant_id = p.id AND v.deleted_at IS NOT NULL AND v.delete_cause <> 'pacticipant' WHERE p.tenant_id = $1::uuid AND p.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY v.deleted_at DESC, v.id DESC LIMIT $2
